paragraphs: Rabbi Oshaya bar Chiyya, Rabbi Oshaya Berabbi, and Rabbi Chiyya Berabbi, all together, Yevamot 46, end of b; see Rashi. “He taught it and he said it: the law follows Rabbi Natan.” Rashi: he recites the mishnah from his teacher and states the ruling himself, Chullin 31a. Yuchasin cites this, but that name is not there: only Rabbi Oshaya the younger of Chavraya.
